confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Gothenburg price indexes. The food and drink anchors come from crowdsourced or aggregated sources that disagree with each other. Those sources gave an inexpensive meal of about SEK 125-150, a mid-range meal for two of about SEK 600-1,000, a cappuccino of about SEK 40-45, and a 0.5 L draft beer of about SEK 63-80. Cocktail and wine were not searched. I set them from the usual Swedish relationship to beer, with a cocktail at about 2x beer and a glass of wine at about 1.6x beer. The accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation prices or look at any listings. Seasonal and event-driven swings are large in Gothenburg. The SEK-to-USD conversion for the food and drink anchors is approximate, at roughly 0.10 USD per SEK.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Stockholm and Copenhagen. Gothenburg is a little cheaper than Stockholm and well below Copenhagen or Oslo. Hostel and budget-hotel supply is limited, so those prices are firm.
